description: This file implements an LLM Guard integration for content moderation in a software project. It defines a class `_ENTERPRISE_LLMGuard` which handles moderation checks via an external API, enforces content policies, and manages moderation hooks for various call types like completion, embeddings, image generation, etc.

classes.name: _ENTERPRISE_LLMGuard
classes.description: A class that manages content moderation checks via an external LLM Guard API, including methods for moderation, hook processing, and response validation.

methods.name: __init__( self, mock_testing: bool = False, mock_redacted_text: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Initializes the LLM Guard with optional mock testing parameters and retrieves API base URL from secrets.

methods.name: moderation_check(self, text: str)
methods.description: Performs moderation analysis on the provided text via an external API, raising HTTP exceptions if content violates policies.

methods.name: bool should_proceed(self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, data: dict)
methods.description: Determines whether to proceed with moderation based on guard mode and permissions.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Main hook that performs moderation check before processing a request, formatting prompts accordingly.
